summary: The Social Hub is hotel chain, founded in 2005. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 8 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 3 about acquisitions.

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam-born hybrid hotel, student housing and coworking chain; entry jobs and internships in English, but not an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Calls itself a fun, creative place that acts like a hotel but also offers student housing, gyms, events, a rooftop bar and coworking.
Its 8 jobs are spread over Delft, Amsterdam, Eindhoven and Groningen, mostly entry level and internships in guest service and marketing.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
None of its 8 jobs here require Dutch, though none mention visa support.

growth.text: Opened a large new location in Rome.
Its Glasgow hotel generated about £10m of social value in its first year.

worth_knowing.text: Investors Ardian and Rockfield took a majority stake in The Social Hub Berlin.
Appointed a new Chief Operating Officer.
Nominated as one of the Coolest Dutch Brands.
